tokens.sent: The Kalahari is a large area of bush land in southern Africa.
But the grass and the bushes soon get dry and turn brown again.
They live in huts, eat wild animals – even lions – plants and berries.
One of these is the Chimbu skeleton dancers.
They paint skeletons onto their bodies.
This makes them look scarier and it frightens other people away from their land.
The Nenets are nomadic, meaning they frequently move from one place to another.
Each year around 300,000 reindeer move around the land and the Nenets always go with them.
The Bayan-Ölgii Province is the highest part of Mongolia.
It is also home to the Kazakh golden eagle hunters.
When boys turn 13, they can become golden eagle hunters.
There are about 100,000 Kazakh people, but only around 250 of them are golden eagle hunters.
